meta.title: Dora-Benjamin-Park 12 · Furnished flat in Berlin-Stralau
meta.description: Furnished two-room flat on the Stralau peninsula in Berlin-Friedrichshain for employees and project staff, for about two to six months or longer. Available from 1 December 2026.
hero.title: Furnished flat on the Stralau peninsula
hero.lead: Two rooms, 57 m², 50 metres from the river Spree. To rent for employees, skilled professionals and project staff who live in Berlin for a few months. Available from 1 December 2026.
flat.title: The flat
flat.p1: The flat is on the first floor of a house built in 2015 and has about 57 m². Both rooms have floor-to-ceiling bay windows that let in a lot of light. From the living room you look through the trees onto the river Spree and the excursion boats on the other bank.
flat.p2: The living and dining area has a fully equipped fitted kitchen. The bedroom is on the quiet side. The bathroom was renovated in 2024 and has a walk-in shower and a heated towel rail. The hallway has two built-in wardrobes and a small dressing area, plus a storage room. There is parquet flooring throughout and underfloor heating.
flat.p3: The flat is furnished: the bedroom has a double bed (160 × 200 cm), the living room a sofa and a dining area. For working from home there is a desk with a desk chair. A washing machine is in the utility room. There is no balcony, but there is a shared garden at the house. A playground lies in front of the window, so you will hear children playing during the day.

terms.title: Terms
terms.p1: The flat is rented furnished for residential use, to companies for their employees or directly to professionals who work in Berlin temporarily. It is intended for a period of about two to six months, and longer if needed.
terms.p2: This is not a holiday rental. Bed linen and a basic set of kitchen and bathroom items are provided. Everything else, such as the move-in date and rental period, we arrange in direct contact.
area.title: The area: Stralau
area.p1: Stralau is a narrow peninsula in Friedrichshain, surrounded on three sides by the river Spree and Rummelsburg Bay. It used to be a fishing village, and some of that village character remains: little traffic, many trees, meadows and water everywhere. Directly in front of the house is Dora-Benjamin-Park with a playground and benches.
area.p2: A waterside path runs around the whole peninsula, good for walking, running or cycling. Across the river, on the Treptow side, the excursion boats depart.
area.p3: Treptower Park S-Bahn station is about 5 minutes on foot, Ostkreuz station about 10 minutes. From there, S-Bahn trains go in all directions, including directly to BER airport. A supermarket and several cafés are within walking distance. Boxhagener Platz, the RAW site, the East Side Gallery and Treptower Park are only a few minutes away by bike.
